title: Prepare for the Philippines e-invoicing requirements
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
### Built for the Philippines' Near-Real-Time Reporting Model


The mandate's pressure demands that tax reporting and buyer delivery stay synchronised across two connected flows. What is unique here: the near-real-time reporting model is an Accounts Receivable mandate obliging taxpayers to report invoices to the Bureau of Internal Revenue EIS platform in JSON via API first, after which the invoice can be transmitted to the buyer in any format.


Vertex enables your organization to:


###


Convert enterprise resource planning data into validated JSON automatically.


###


Report signed invoices to the authority in near real time.


###


Deliver buyer invoices separately in any agreed format.


###


Integrate authority acknowledgements back into the enterprise resource planning system.
